import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,7); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5,6.5,'insulated roof 100mm PU',ha='center',fontsize=9)
rect=plt.Rectangle((1,1),8,5,fill=False,lw=2); ax.add_patch(rect)
ax.text(0.2,3,'wall\n100mm',fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((3,1.5),4,2,fill=False,lw=1.5))
ax.text(5,2.2,'1 tonne crates',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.text(7.5,5,'evaporator\n+ fan',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='blue')
ax.annotate('',xy=(6.5,4.5),xytext=(7.5,4.7),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='blue'))
ax.annotate('',xy=(3.5,4.0),xytext=(6.0,4.5),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='blue'))
ax.text(5,0.4,'floor drain for condensate',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(1.2,5.7,'cold air flow',fontsize=8,color='blue')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=120)
